reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and the cited paragraphs (Section 8 covenants of Client, Section 10 heading) contain no non-solicitation, no-hire, or inducement obligation binding the Customer — consistent with the playbook's preferred position of no non-solicit on Customer.
No redline or counterparty comment is expected or supplied for a compliant finding; the unchanged rendered text correctly mirrors the original paragraphs.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are inapplicable here: those parameters only matter if a non-solicit exists, so their absence is evidence of compliance rather than a defect.

Rationale accurately notes the only 'Non-Competition Agreement' reference (Section 8(d)) constrains TrueLink's use of Credit Data, not Client hiring, and correctly identifies the fallback we would demand if a non-solicit were later proposed.
